title: Assertion
description: Every leaf value in the system is one. A discriminated union on `confidence`, so the obligations of each class are structural rather than remembered: FACT owes evidence, INFERENCE owes what it was derived from, UNKNOWN owes a reason and what would recover it.

evidenceRef.description: An evidence id where an evidence pool exists to reference — an envelope carries `evidence[]` and its assertions cite ids — or the evidence itself where the assertion stands alone, as every assertion in the Context Package does. Both forms occur in the frozen documents and both are the same evidence.

probe.description: The probe or dispatch that produced this assertion. Required so that every assertion names its source, agent-authored inferences included.

evidence.description: A FACT with no evidence is an INFERENCE that has not admitted it.

derived_from.description: Assertion or evidence ids this was reasoned from.

recoverable_by.description: What would resolve it. This is what makes an unknown actionable rather than decorative, and it is what the uncertainty ladder's rung 2 dispatches.
